resolution_method: UNESCO World Heritage component 144-002 supplies an authoritative point locator for the archaeological site of Songo Mnara. The point is used only as the site/evidence locus; it is not a slavery-practice extent, Kilwa polity polygon, or Swahili-coast generalization.
